entries.title: Fixed Interlinked Chain-Curtain Disc Basket
entries.description: One newly authored complete static disc-golf-style target basket. A whole ground pedestal supports the central mast, broad upper suspension disc and separate deep open receiving basket. Twelve suspended chains each contain eight complete rectangular annular links with alternating planes, genuine open apertures and full opposed bar contact in one fixed interlocked pose. Their upper ends seat inside the suspension disc and lower ends meet a complete collar around the mast. Below, twelve continuous whole bottom-and-side wires meet a real central floor hub and full open upper rim, leaving a genuinely empty catching bowl. Unlike the old backboard basketball stand with straight net strands and an open bottom, this whole centred chain-curtain and lower catcher has no rear board or forward hoop; unlike the old horizontal crank sphere cage, it has no spherical enclosure, side axle or crank. Entire geometry newly authored, no old cage or net imported. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and whole ground-centred origin. One complete prop, zero scenes; chains and links are not counted as independent assets. Static illustrative pose only: no disc-flight capture, rebound, chain dynamics, gameplay specification, stability, installation, load, manufacture or sporting-safety claim. No disc, player, scoring labels, textures or environment.

entries.title: Fixed Twin-Guide Round-Platform Speed Bag Stand
entries.description: One newly authored complete static speed-bag platform stand. Two long grounded runners and low triangular braces carry two complete tall polygonal guide posts and top/bottom cross ties. One fixed bridge has two real full-length matched-bore sleeves around those guides, rear lock-knob appearances, two forward cantilever rails and upper diagonal braces supporting a complete thick circular wooden rebound platform. A short actual underside boss and fixed connector enter one whole softly shouldered pear-shaped bag directly below the platform. This is not the previous long four-strap cylindrical heavy bag hung from a single tall eye, nor a cable/weight pulldown tower: the whole guided deck carriage and short direct bag-to-platform relationship are newly authored. All geometry new; only mature generic helpers reused. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, native metres and Z up, whole horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes. Static fixed appearance only: no adjustment travel, sliding mechanism, hinge or swivel simulation, rebound behavior, punching response, exercise suitability, load rating, manufacture or equipment-safety claim. No athlete, text, textures or surrounding room.

entries.title: Fixed Edge Bed and Rear Thread Mast Overlock Machine
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed tabletop overlock-sewing-machine-style exterior. A compact asymmetric case has a short projecting left head over a small outboard edge bed with a genuine needle-plate slot, a broad lower front enclosure and one full right-side handwheel. Separate blunt needle-bar and presser-foot appearances occupy the open edge-working gap. Four front tension-disc appearances are backed by the head, while an integrated rear platform holds four opaque whole cone exteriors under a tall complete mast and horizontal guide bar with four actual open eyelets. Four finite flat feet support the whole base. No large open C throat, dedicated sewing table, chair or foot treadle is copied from the old lockstitch workstation. All numeric geometry new; one prop zero scenes and three opaque materials. Static game art only: no fabric, cutting blade, continuous threading path, needle movement, actual tension, stitches, motor operation, manufacture, ergonomic or machine-safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Nested Shaft and Radial Planetary Display
entries.description: One newly authored complete static tabletop planetary-model display. A broad stepped ground base and three full turned columns support an annular upper deck, leaving an actual open lower bay with two independent toothed-disk appearances on complete upright shafts. A shaped side bearing block carries a full horizontal shaft, offset hand crank and grip. Above the deck, four complete truly bored concentric sleeves have different crown heights and independently carry whole bent radial arms, full outer vertical stems and closed faceted planet-model spheres. A separate complete central spindle supports the larger central sun-model sphere. The new low mechanism-base and nested-axis/radial-carrier whole relation is not an armillary ring cage with added balls or a gimballed flywheel with its rim removed; no old component geometry is reused. Four planets are subordinate parts of one illustrative device, not four separately counted models, and their arbitrary colours/sizes do not define the new asset. Closed editable solids, four opaque untextured constant PBR roles, metres, native Z up and actual horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. One model, zero scenes. Frozen fictional teaching-display exterior only: deliberate fixed overlaps and separated gear levels are not functioning bearings or a meshing drive. No motion, accurate planet identity, orbital position, astronomical time, orbital or body scale, gear ratio, calibration, instruction, manufacture, balance, stability, load, ergonomics or safety certification.

entries.title: Fixed Round Screen and Cross Stage Comparator
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed tabletop round-screen profile-comparator appearance. A broad footed base and integral-height rear support carry one large deep circular screen housing, a genuinely recessed opaque blank screen, and a separate short downward objective assembly under the housing. In front, a lower longitudinal guide frame, independent carriage, two transverse-direction rails and an upper open stage frame form two visibly distinct orthogonal slide levels. Two separate stemmed control knobs belong to the different levels. A complete side-supported short illuminator-like barrel with recessed opaque face points across the empty stage region. No workpiece, projected image, marked scale, crosshair, optical ray, old camera, bellows or imported geometry. One whole prop, zero scenes; four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up and horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. Fixed overlap interfaces are artistic, not a functional mechanism. entries.title: Fixed Slotted Circular Needle Bed Knitting Machine
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed circular-knitting-device exterior. A thick whole rear C-clamp and upper cantilever support a fully open annular machine case. One connected needle cylinder has a continuous lower band and genuine open top slots; separate full blunt bent needle appearances rise through those slots. One continuous finite-thickness ribbed textile tube passes inside the annulus and hangs down with both ends truly open. A complete side drive housing, shaft, crank arm and thick grip, plus a tall mast, integrated full supply bobbin, high guide arm, real open eye and one continuous feed-yarn appearance, belong to this single device. The whole circular needle-bed and through-tube relation is newly authored, not the old C-arm sewing workstation, floor loom, current overlock edge-bed case, spool rack or yarn swift resized or recoloured. Needle count and fabric ribs are subordinate details, never separate new assets. Closed editable solids, four opaque untextured constant PBR roles, metres, native Z up and actual horizontal bounds-centred ground datum at the lower clamp jaw.
